title: Fix pattern constraint review findings (guard fallback leak, deny message, coverage)
description:
Three findings from vidhi-review of sutra/240-243 arc:

1. **guard-fallback-pattern-leak (medium/correctness)**: When extract_proposed_imports returns None, guard falls back to check_file_constraints which calls evaluate_raw with SingleFile scope. evaluate_raw's pattern scan reads disk content and reports ALL matches without introduced-only filtering — pre-existing blocking patterns cause a false deny even though check_proposed_patterns already passed. Fix: filter forbidden_pattern findings from the fallback constraint_findings in bin/guard.rs.

2. **deny-message-language-specific (low/design)**: format_pattern_deny hardcodes Rust concepts ("shared ownership", "references/lifetimes"). Confusing for non-Rust patterns. Fix: make guidance generic or language-aware.

3. **coverage-ignores-language (low/design)**: constraint_coverage for ForbiddenPattern counts all files in scope regardless of language, suppressing dead-constraint warnings for language-mismatched scopes. Fix: filter by extension match.

acceptance_criteria.text: Guard fallback path does not produce false denials from pre-existing pattern matches
format_pattern_deny message is language-generic or adapts to the constraint's language
constraint_coverage for ForbiddenPattern filters by the constraint's language extensions

root_cause: Three issues from arc 240-243: (1) evaluate_raw pattern scan runs without introduced-only semantics, leaking through when guard falls back to check_file_constraints; (2) deny message hardcoded Rust idioms from the initial design spec; (3) constraint_coverage counted all files in scope without filtering by the constraint's target language extensions.
